title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.00 (quiet) at 01:00 UTC on 20 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 20 日 01:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 1.00 (label 1Z). Last-180-sample maximum is 2.00 (at 23:57 UTC on 19 September); published-window maximum is 2.00 (same time). Hours through 18:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window; 19:00 UTC is partially rolled out (52 samples from 19:08). Completed bins 20:00–00:00 UTC closed at 1.67 / 0.00 / 1.00 / 2.00 / 1.33 respectively (20:00 peak 1.67 / 2M at 20:05, 60 samples; 21:00 peak 0.00 / 0Z, closed at 0.00 / 0Z, 60 samples; 22:00 peak 1.00 / 1Z at 22:43, 60 samples; 23:00 peak 2.00 / 2Z at 23:57, closed at 2.00 / 2Z, 60 samples; 00:00 peak 1.33 / 1P at 00:31, closed at 1.33 / 1P, 60 samples). 01:00 UTC bin is in progress (6 samples; peak 1.33 / 1P at 01:02; latest sample 0.67 / 1M at 01:05). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute (01:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~358 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file. The in-progress 01:00 UTC hour currently has 6 samples and may be revised as NOAA updates.

title.en: A magnitude 4.9 earthquake occurred 85 km W of Hihifo, Tonga on 20 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 20 日，東加希希福以西約 85 公里發生規模 4.9 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.9, depth about 10 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.2 (us7000tild, Reykjanes Ridge).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.9，深度約 10 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.2（us7000tild，雷克雅內斯海嶺）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
